title: Bridge package marker

claims.text: The package docstring in lineage/bridge/__init__.py declares explicitly configured, headless external client boundaries.

triggers: where is the external client configured

decision.rule: Change here when the bridge package boundary or its external-client contract needs to change.
decision.failure: Bridge imports resolve to an unexpected module or the package provides no client boundary.
